title: Task Specifications & Success Criteria
description: Study define the output contract, provide relevant context, specify missing-information behavior, and separate content and presentation constraints. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Define the output contract
lessons.description: Rewrite the task with explicit length, evidence and omission rules.
lessons.conceptOverview: A useful prompt specifies the task, audience, required output and success criteria. Separate essential constraints from optional style so evaluation can distinguish correctness from presentation.
lessons.whyItMatters: Clear output contracts make prompt behavior testable.

lessons.title: Provide relevant context
lessons.description: Select the relevant policy and label its effective date.

lessons.title: Specify missing-information behavior
lessons.description: Define an explicit null or unknown representation and a validation check.

lessons.title: Separate content and presentation constraints
lessons.description: Revise the contract to prioritize required evidence and define a bounded fallback.
lessons.conceptOverview: Content constraints define what must be true; presentation constraints define how it appears. Test both, and resolve conflicts in favor of the task's essential requirements.
